page.overview:
Who is "Freakin' Guns" Guy?

The "Freakin' Guns" Guy is a prospective police officer in Springfield. He makes his first and only appearance in "The Springfield Connection."

During police training, he impatiently asked, "When do we get the freakin' guns?!" Chief Wiggum replied that he needed to reveal his name first. This angered him greatly, which caused him to storm away fuming.

His character references the Police Academy film series.
